submitted.rationale: Mg-Sb-O is a wide-gap system: MgO and MgSb2O6 have band gaps well above 2.1 eV, so little photoresponse is expected. Across the five measured compositions (Sb fraction 0.08 to 0.81), EQE was essentially zero everywhere, at about the noise level. Index 0 gave the highest value, 0.00092%. All the other readings were zero or slightly negative.

rejected.reason: MgSb2O6 trirutile composition; EQE -0.00014%, essentially zero
